# 2 Baruch Chapter 39 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**39:1** Hear therefore the interpretation of the cedar tree.

**39:2** The great forest which you saw — that represents the matter of the four kingdoms which will rule over your people; and their rule will be troubled and distressed.

**39:3** And as for what you saw — the cedar which remained from the forest, and the vine coming and subduing it and making nothing of it with the water —

**39:4** This is what it means: the last ruler who will remain from that forest of wickedness, who commanded over all of them — he will be bound and brought up to Mount Zion.

**39:5** And my Anointed One will convict him of all his wickedness and will assemble against him all his hosts.

**39:6** And afterward my Anointed One will kill him, and will protect the rest of my people who will be found in the place which I have chosen.

**39:7** And his dominion will stand firm forever, until the world of corruption has ended and until the times aforesaid have been fulfilled.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering. Key decisions: "my Anointed One" (vv.5-6) retained as the messianic title over PNEUMA's "my Anointed One" — all three agree; "dominion" (v.7) over EMET's "principate" — "dominion" is more natural English for the Syriac shultana; "forest of wickedness" (v.4) retained as a significant phrase.*
